# Akademicka Platforma Czasopism

> UMK's multidisciplinary open-access academic journal platform providing peer-reviewed scholarly articles across humanities, social sciences, and natural sciences.

Akademicka Platforma Czasopism (APCZ) is an academic publishing platform operated by Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń, Poland. It hosts numerous Polish and international peer-reviewed journals using Open Journal Systems technology, supporting open-access scholarly publishing across diverse academic disciplines.

## Journal Discovery & Access

- [Akademicka Platforma Czasopism](https://apcz.umk.pl): Homepage for Akademicka Platforma Czasopism, UMK's multidisciplinary open-access academic journal platform
- [Journal Index](https://apcz.umk.pl/index/index): Main index page for journal discovery and browsing on Akademicka Platforma Czasopism
- [Journal Directory](https://apcz.umk.pl/index/journals): Complete directory listing of peer-reviewed journals on the platform
- [Research Categories](https://apcz.umk.pl/index/categories): Research categories and subject classification for academic journals
